tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Dirichlet growth implies Hölder continuity] 1. ch12:12.2\group chapter-12Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0310 Let $w\in C^1(\Omega )$ and $\widetilde\Omega \Subset \Omega $ with $\operatorname {dist}(\widetilde\Omega ,\partial \Omega )>R$. Suppose \[ \mathcal D(r;z)\le Cr^{2\alpha } \] for every $z\in \widetilde\Omega $ and $r\le R'\le R$. If $z_1,z_2\in \widetilde\Omega $ and $|z_1-z_2|\le R'$, then \[ |w(z_2)-w(z_1)| \le 2\sqrt{\frac C\alpha }\, |z_2-z_1|^\alpha . \]
Proof

\sketch Apply the two-dimensional Morrey estimate to $w$ and use Cauchy–Schwarz to express its hypothesis through $\mathcal D(r;z)$.

□
